name: Jun Li
biography: Jun Li is a senior security researcher at the UnicornTeam, Qihoo 360. He is the POC of DEF CON Group 010, and member of the DEF CON Group Global Advisory Board. His researches have been presented at conferences such as Blackhat, DEF CON, HITB, KCon, SyScan360, ISC, etc. His is interested in IoT security and connected car security. Along with his colleagues, has previously found several automobile vulnerabilities in Tesla, GM cars, Volvo, BMW, Audi, Mercedes Benz and BYD. He is the author of <<_________>> ("Connected Car Security Demystified"). He is also the co-author of "Inside Radio: An Attack & Defense Guide".
